title: Hoadlbahn Cable Car Axamer Lizum & Hoadl
name: Hoadlbahn Cable Car Axamer Lizum & Hoadl
kurzbeschreibung: The modern Hoadlbahn in the Axamer Lizum at 2,340 m: Hoadl-Haus featuring the Alps' largest covered panoramic terrace with views of the Kalkkögel.
beschreibung:
Overview

The modern Hoadlbahn in the world-famous Axamer Lizum (municipality of Axams, Bezirk Innsbruck-Land) provides access to the 2,340-metre-high panoramic peak Hoadl in the heart of the North Tyrolean Kalkkögel. Located just 20 kilometres southwest of the provincial capital Innsbruck, the 10-passenger gondola newly constructed in 2022 links the Lizum valley floor at 1,560 metres with the sun-drenched summit plateau in two sections in just about six minutes. As a two-time host venue of the Olympic Winter Games (1964 and 1976), the Axamer Lizum enjoys cult alpine status as a legendary mountain destination.

Hoadl-Haus & the North Tyrolean Dolomites

At the top of the Hoadl, visitors are greeted by the architecturally striking Hoadl-Haus, boasting the largest covered sun terrace in the entire Alps: thanks to an enormous, fully automated retractable glass façade, the restaurant transforms into an airy open-air haven when the sun shines. From here, guests enjoy breathtaking vistas of the vertically rising rock spires of the Kalkkögel—frequently referred to as the 'North Tyrolean Dolomites' due to their jagged pinnacles. In summer, the plateau serves as a launchpad for challenging via ferratas, panoramic hikes across the Hochtennboden, and the scenic descent via the Damen-Olympiahang. Informative display boards and photo points commemorate the triumphs of alpine ski legends from past Olympic decades.

Visit & Getting There

The Hoadlbahn in the Axamer Lizum operates during the summer season from early July until late September, daily from 08:30 to 16:30. Summer lift tickets (2025/2026 season): round trip adults approx. €26.00, seniors approx. €23.50, youths approx. €20.50, children approx. €13.00. Holders of the regional Welcome Card Plus receive discounts. Arriving by car: From Innsbruck via Götzens and Axams along the regional road up into the Axamer Lizum (large free car park directly at the valley station). By public transport: From Innsbruck Hauptbahnhof main station, VVT bus route 4162 runs hourly directly to the valley station of the Hoadlbahn.

Tips

The gondola lift and the Hoadl-Haus mountain restaurant are step-free and fully accessible for wheelchair users and strollers. Indulge in fresh apple strudel with vanilla sauce on the panoramic terrace while taking in unimpeded views of the Schlicker Seeschneid and the majestic Stubai glacier giants.
